items.a: A virtual employee that attracts customers and serves them. On one side it runs your marketing (strategy, content and ads); on the other, an agent answers your messages on WhatsApp and Instagram and closes the sale.

items.q: Is the marketing part available yet?
items.a: We're rolling it out business by business while we finish polishing it. The support agent is ready. Log in and we'll tell you where you stand.

items.q: Which channels does it work on?
items.a: Support on WhatsApp and Instagram. Posting on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. Ads on Meta Ads, Google Ads and TikTok Ads.

items.q: Do I need to know marketing or tech?
items.a: No. You tell it in plain language what you sell, to whom and how you want it to speak. AVENTHRA builds the rest and you approve.

items.q: Can the agent make things up?
items.a: It won't answer anything outside the information you loaded. If it doesn't know something, it says so and lets you know.
For most small businesses, yes: it covers strategy, content, ads and support. If you work with an agency, AVENTHRA takes the repetitive work off their hands.
